newsitem.title: USA: TransAmerican to close on Sanifill assets.
newsitem.headline: TransAmerican to close on Sanifill assets.

text.p: TransAmerican Waste Industries Inc said it expected its previously announced purchase of the Houston-area assets of Sanifill Inc would close on January 31.

The U.S. Justice Department required that USA Waste Services Inc divest these assets as part of its merger with Sanifill, TransAmerican said. TranAmerican said it would acquire the assets for $13.6 million in cash.
TransAmerican said its president Jerry Kruszka had assumed genaral management of the assets effective immediately.

The assets consist of 58 commercial and residential routes, 63 collection vehicles, about 4,000 containers, two offices and maintenance facilities and a construction and demolition landfill, the company said.
